purpose: Smallest bounded diagnostic of the former Colab Vietnamese reference-vocal path on a reproducible T4 backend pin

required_before_run: client confirms ownership or sufficient rights and consent for the reference voice and media
client approves the exact T4 time and provider cost ceiling
all CPU-only code and evidence gates pass

reference_media.source: local private video; never committed or uploaded before approval
reference_media.privacy: record only checksum, duration, format, and consent record; never lyrics, filename, or identity in public evidence

success_contract: the allocated device is exactly a Tesla T4
the exact source and model revisions are recorded
the runtime reports float32 for the protected numerical path
the output is finite, non-silent, non-clipped, and duration-valid
peak VRAM and OOM classification are recorded
the artifact downloads with a matching SHA-256
the app stops with zero active containers
stop_conditions: no T4 container before the bounded timeout
NaN, OOM, silence, clipping, corruption, or wrong duration
first attempt reaches any terminal state; no automatic retry
